failure_analysis: All trials passed all hidden cases, so there are no failed hidden cases to diagnose. The docs worked well for this task because the Tag Processor overview says to use it for flat attribute/class edits and byte-precise preservation, while the HTML Processor docs say the heavier processor is for document structure. The get_attribute_names_with_prefix() section exposes the exact needed operation and documents lowercase returned names plus case-insensitive matching, which covered uppercase source attributes. The next_tag() section says only real tags match and tag-like text in comments/raw text is not modified, which covered comments. get_updated_html() clearly says it is the way to read back queued attribute edits while preserving untouched bytes. Near-miss: remove_attribute() itself is sparse; subjects succeeded because they inferred that lowercase names returned by get_attribute_names_with_prefix() are valid inputs even when the source attribute casing differs.

doc_gaps.problem: The method says only that it removes an attribute from the current tag. It does not explicitly state whether matching is ASCII case-insensitive or whether normalized lowercase names from get_attribute_names_with_prefix() are valid for mixed-case source attributes.
doc_gaps.suggestion: Add a sentence: attribute-name matching is ASCII case-insensitive, so names returned by get_attribute_names_with_prefix() may be passed directly to remove_attribute(), regardless of source casing.

doc_gaps.problem: The docs show a data-* example but do not spell out literal prefix boundary behavior, which is important for distinguishing similar names such as attr, attr-x, and attr-extra.
doc_gaps.suggestion: Clarify that the supplied prefix is matched literally against normalized attribute names; it does not apply word, hyphen, or namespace boundary rules beyond the characters in the prefix.

doc_gaps.location: Tag Processor overview / Modifying HTML attributes
doc_gaps.problem: The overview shows single-attribute removal but does not cross-link the prefix enumeration API as the documented way to perform bulk attribute edits on the current tag.
doc_gaps.suggestion: Add a short general pattern note that callers can enumerate matching attribute names with get_attribute_names_with_prefix() and then apply set/remove operations to those names while still returning get_updated_html().
